remarks: Beautifully remodeled cape with great curb appeal located on desirable cul-de- sac, walking distance to train, farmer's market , library, town & minutes to beach. Front door opens to spacious entry, that greets one with an amazing open- plan main floor, flooded with light with views of the stunning back yard.The Chef's kitchen has custom cabinetry, floating shelves & professional grade appliances.. Striking marble counter & center island top are complemented by glass tile backsplash.Large island has sink and cabinetry on both sides with seating for 4.The kitchen opens to a spacious dining room with trey ceiling rimmed by lighting. The dining room in turn opens to a seating area with sliding doors to a stone patio & garden as well as a beautiful family room with gas fireplace , built-ins & a vaulted ceiling. One step down is a separate area with heated floor tiles, surrounded by glass sliders & doors. The formal living room boasts an original oversized bay window & dramatic wall with FP & built in dry bar. A sun room on the other side of entry hall, has vaulted ceiling, ceiling fan and glass sliding doors. This room leads to the heated 2 car garage. The upper level boasts a primary suite and 3 more bedrooms and full bath. There are hardwood floors through out the house.  Lower level has finished rec room, cedar closet and utility room. Charm galore, sun drenched main floor and a beautiful professionally landscaped half acre make this a house you won't want to leave!

facts.laundryLoc: Separate laundry room with heated floor.
